value.rationale: Determining whether an edge can be identified when sensor labels are erased is the motivating invariant of the source. For the standard infinite family of width-two path grids, the theorem identifies a sharp three-stage existence/minimum transition and a structurally nonmonotone eight-column exception; this information is not an automatic ordered-edge-metric result. Exact exceptional optimizer counts and a fully checkable finite obstruction certificate reinforce a motivated, natural family classification.
